```{r}
if(!require(pacman)) install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(DiagrammeR, dplyr, ggplot2, DiagrammeRsvg, rsvg, here)
```



```{r}

# Define the flowchart
graph <- grViz("
digraph flowchart {

  graph [layout = dot, rankdir = TB]
  node [shape = box, style = filled, color = lightgrey, fontname = Helvetica]
  edge [fontname = Helvetica]

  # Inclusion/Exclusion (Separate group)
  subgraph cluster_inclusion {
    label = 'Inclusion Criteria'
    style = dashed
    color = grey
    B1 [label = 'Inclusion:\\nHW, CBO, >18 years', shape = diamond, color = lightblue]
    B2 [label = 'Experience:\\nChatbot & COVID-19 Response', shape = diamond, color = lightblue]
  }

  # Preparation Activities
  subgraph cluster_preparation {
    label = 'Preparation Activities'
    style = dashed
    color = lightgrey
    A1 [label = 'Participant Invitation\\n(20 from MoH, 20 from CBO)\\nStratified by Health Zone, Districts, CBO']
    A2 [label = 'Pre-Survey\\n(Participants complete TAM pre-survey)']
  }

  # Workshop Activities
  subgraph cluster_workshop {
    label = 'Workshop Activities'
    style = dashed
    color = darkgrey
    A3 [label = 'National Work']
    A4 [label = 'Day 1']
    A5 [label = 'Day 2 (Half Day)']
    A6 [label = 'Discuss the future Role of Chatbot']

    C1 [label = 'Morning:\\n- Retrospective & Pre-survey Presentation\\n- MARS Toolkit Presentation']
    C2 [label = 'Afternoon:\\n- MARS Tool Practice\\n- Group Discussion\\n- Presentations']
    C3 [label = 'TAM Post-Survey']
  }

  # Connections
  B1 -> B2
  B2 -> A1
  A1 -> A2
  A2 -> A3
  A3 -> A4
  A4 -> C1
  A4 -> C2
  A3 -> A5
  A5 -> C3
  A5 -> A6
}
")

# Convert to SVG
svg_graph <- export_svg(graph)

# Save as PNG with 300 DPI
rsvg_png(charToRaw(svg_graph),  file ="workshop_flowchart.png", width = 6400, height = 4500)


```
